verdict.rationale: The Comptroller's own franchise-tax page directs filers to an 'Interest Owed and Earned' resource for calculating interest on past-due taxes and offers an extension request, so it publishes some late-payment interest information and acknowledges deadlines. The pack shows no actual due dates, penalty percentages, or interest rates. Missing for 10: exact filing due dates, exact late-filing/late-payment penalty figures, published interest rate values, extension deadline details, independent corroboration.
